title: 第3章 巨剑第4章 大好人

第三章 巨剑
张羊是张家现有的第三代，张家在高日城可是名门望族，有着两百多年的历史，家主的话就来城主大人也需要斟酌一番。而身为张家当代家主的孙子，张羊却过得一点都不愉快。
因为，他的体型，微胖的身材让他出手笨重，在剑道诡变的比斗中，往往他就是被人虐待的对象。加上张羊性格厚实，就更容易遭到欺负，今天几个世家年轻一代聚集，马上他就成了被欺凌的对象，有几个别的世家子弟欺负他，没想到他本家的几名兄弟竟然在一旁嗤笑，没有半点上前解围的意思。
这一幕，让那几个世家子弟更加放肆，终于把张羊给惹恼了，奋起反抗。还别说，尽管张羊体型胖而动作缓慢，可是力气着实不小，而那几个世家子弟没有料到张羊敢反抗，顿时全部被掀倒在地，摔了个狗吃泥巴。
如此，张羊自然成为了众矢之的，于是开始有人正式向张羊提出挑战。可惜，张羊身手笨重，根本攻击不到对方，而身上则被人划开了不少口中，一怒之下张羊奋力一击，没想到砍在地上，把剑给砍断了。
没了武器，比斗自然继续不下去，但是众人还是不肯放过张羊，于是张羊重新换过一件衣服后，便准备回家拿剑。事实上张羊也咽不下这口气，厚实人发恼起来，也是很可怕的。
不过回家的路中，张羊发现了一家新开的剑坊，名字也挺古怪的，叫叶石剑坊。当然这不是吸引张羊的原因，而是那匾额下面，写着新业开张，一律六折的字样，让张羊停下脚步。
这样颠颠簸簸的回家拿剑，还不如在这里买几柄算了，反正也不差这几个钱，于是张羊在思考片刻后，终于踏进这条不归路，认识了他眼里的‘大好人’兼‘大哥’叶石。
“你怎么知道我外号就叫肥羊，你认识我？”张羊一脸疑惑的看着叶石，记忆中没有见过这人，但对方怎么知道他的外号。
叶石也是一愣，没想到有人的外号竟然会如此的……意蕴深长，但是叶石也是忽悠好手，当初被他忽悠买剑的人可是不少，如果不是遇见那无良客服，反被忽悠走四百块钱，叶石都要自封忽悠之王了。
“这样公子爷叫？”叶石想要问下对方的名字，眼珠子微微一转，开始想着对策。
“张家，张羊。”张羊胸口一挺，很是自豪的说着，在高日城，身为张家子弟，确实有骄傲的本钱。不过张羊这‘胸肌’却不给面子，胸口挺起立刻看出胸口鼓胀，破坏了其威严的形象。
听到张羊的话，叶石哪还不知道这张羊的外号怎么来的，暗想这外号真是神来之笔，看模样这张羊也确实是只肥羊，不宰实在对不起自己。但表面上，叶石则是装出一副崇拜的模样，“在这高日城，有谁不认识张羊少爷，是那张家的……张家公子。”
叶石擦了擦手掌，拍马屁差点拍出篓子来，谁知道这张羊在张家是什么身份啊，别一不小心说漏了嘴，把到手的肥羊给气跑了。
张羊听着十分受用，原本郁闷的心情好上不少，看着眼前的叶石，也是一阵顺眼。不过等到他看向贩卖的剑时，却是眼睛一亮，认准了似的，一下子跑到巨剑堆面前，两眼放光的问道：“这是什么剑。”
“呃，这是巨剑。”叶石有些无语，难道巨剑很惊奇吗，记得当初游戏里可是一大堆人背着巨剑，因为是热门货，叶石当初打造的时候才会多打一些，所以巨剑是店内四种剑具中最多的一种。
看着张羊菲模样不似作假，叶石就有些暗思是不是巨剑这种东西在新世界里没有出现过，那感情好，他作为‘首创人’不是可以大赚一把金钱和名声，只是不知道这东西能申请专利不？
叶石两眼泛星，仿佛看到了未来的美好生活，心中一阵激动啊，这剽窃别人的创造成为自己的首创，感觉就是爽啊。
张羊原本看着巨剑，等着老板的介绍，不想什么也没听见，转头一看，只见这年轻老板似乎陷入什么美好的思念当中。对于打断人的思考，尤其是幸福的思考是一件不礼貌的事情，但张羊还着急着回去，见这年轻老板年纪应该比自己大上一两岁，张羊迟疑着便开了口：“大哥，你醒醒。”
“呃。”叶石顿时惊醒，还没来得及看张羊，就感觉嘴边有些湿润，难不成流口水了，叶石连忙用衣袖擦了擦，上面没有东西，顿时松了口气。

这才看向张羊，叶石见到张羊一脸求解的模样，眼珠子一转，便有了主意，但还是要先介绍一番再说，“这是巨剑，如你所见巨剑剑身比起其他剑宽厚了五倍，在攻击时可以发挥出更足的力量。”
还没等叶石说完，张羊便有些不解的打断，“那这剑的灵活性？”
灵活性一直是张羊心中一个痛，尽管对这巨剑很看上眼，但看模样灵活性不但不会提升，反而还会被拉下一筹，这就让张羊有些迟疑起来了。
“灵活性？”叶石有些怪异的看着张羊，“这剑根本不需要灵活性，一剑挥动，没人能够近得了你的身，近身的你就更不用怕了，扇他，使劲的扇他。”
这次是叶石还没说完，就自己停下了，看着张羊还是一脸迷惑的模样，叶石觉得为了把自己的产品推销出去，需要下苦工了。详细的向张羊解释起来，这巨剑本就是抛弃灵活取威力的武器，一剑轮转身边任何东西都能给拍出去，只要应用得当，这巨剑就是一个领域，没人敢近身。
这时叶石也看出来了，张羊是属于那种身手不敏捷，但力气不小的人，最适合的就是巨剑这种武器。
当然，巨剑也有缺点，就是如果别人拉开距离，不和你打，本身使用巨剑的大多都是体型笨拙的人，再加上巨剑，估计也就只能站着瞪眼了。
不过缺点叶石也跟张羊说了，只说长处不暴短处，这短时间还能糊弄，但时间一长估计名声就坏了。为了长远计划，叶石觉得有必要适当的坦白。
“这么好！”张羊激动的道，看着巨剑的目光更灼热了，要不是有光膜隔着，恐怕他早抢下来摸上一番了。至于那巨剑的缺点，则被张羊无视掉，自从身体胖了之后，张羊就没期待过和人距离战。
“是的是的。”叶石见肥羊上钩，那个眉开眼笑的，搓了搓手，一脸奸商才有的真诚笑容，“虽然我知道张羊公子不在乎这点钱，但本店开张绝不虚口，这巨剑是本店里品质最好的，两百个金币，六折就是一百二十个金币。”
“不贵不贵。”张羊喃喃的说着，眼神全被巨剑给吸引住了。
叶石更是眉开眼笑，成了，肥羊彻底上钩了，这柄剑卖出去，他现在急迫的问题总算解决了。然而没等叶石高兴太久，就被张羊一声惊吼打断。
张羊本来注意力全在巨剑上，对叶石的话听得不大清楚，等到反应过来时，才吓得一下子跳了起来，眼睛泛红，就差点没拉着叶石的衣劲。
“你说多少？一百二十个金币，你确定不是一百二十个银币？”张羊低吼着喊道。
content_en:
Chapter 3 Giant Sword
Zhang Yang is the third generation of the Zhang family. The Zhang family is a well-known family in Gaoricheng with a history of more than two hundred years. If you want to be the head of the family, the city lord also needs to think carefully. But as the grandson of the current head of the Zhang family, Zhang Yang's life was not happy at all.
Because of his size, his slightly chubby figure made him clumsy in his attacks, and he was often the target of abuse in treacherous sword fights. Coupled with Zhang Yang's thick personality, he is more likely to be bullied. Today, several young people from aristocratic families gathered together, and he immediately became the target of bullying. Several other children from aristocratic families bullied him. Unexpectedly, several brothers from his own family actually laughed at him and showed no intention of stepping forward to rescue him.
This scene made the children of the aristocratic families even more impudent, and finally angered Zhang Yang and he rose up to resist. Not to mention, although Zhang Yang is fat and slow in movement, he is really strong. However, those children of the aristocratic family did not expect that Zhang Yang dared to resist, and they were all knocked to the ground immediately, and they were thrown into the mud.
In this way, Zhang Yang naturally became the target of public criticism, so some people began to formally challenge Zhang Yang. Unfortunately, Zhang Yang was clumsy and could not attack the opponent at all, and his body was cut open many times. In anger, Zhang Yang struck hard, but unexpectedly hit the ground and broke the sword.
Without the weapon, the fight could not continue, but everyone still refused to let Zhang Yang go, so Zhang Yang changed his clothes and prepared to go home to get his sword. In fact, Zhang Yang couldn't swallow this breath, and it would be terrible for a solid person to get angry.
But on the way home, Zhang Yang discovered a newly opened sword shop with a strange name, Ye Shi Jianfang. Of course, this was not what attracted Zhang Yang, but the words below the plaque that said all new businesses would receive a 40% discount made Zhang Yang stop.
After going home so bumpily to get the sword, it is better to buy a few swords here. Anyway, it is not short of the money. So after Zhang Yang thought for a moment, he finally stepped on this road of no return and met Ye Shi, the 'good guy' and 'big brother' in his eyes.
"How do you know that my nickname is Fat Sheep? Do you know me?" Zhang Yang looked at Ye Shi with a puzzled face. He had never seen this person in his memory, but how did the other party know his nickname.
Ye Shi was also stunned. He didn't expect someone's nickname to be so...with profound meaning. However, Ye Shi was also a good deceiver. Many people were deceived by him into buying swords. If he hadn't met the unscrupulous customer service and deceived him into taking away 400 yuan, Ye Shi would have called himself the king of deceivers.
"Is this how you call me Young Master?" Ye Shi wanted to ask the other party's name. He rolled his eyes slightly and began to think of countermeasures.
"Zhang family, Zhang Yang." Zhang Yang's chest puffed up and he said very proudly. In Gaoricheng, as a descendant of the Zhang family, he does have the ability to be proud. However, Zhang Yang's 'chest muscles' were not given any face. When his chest was raised, it was immediately obvious that his chest was bulging, which destroyed his majestic image.
After hearing Zhang Yang's words, Ye Shi still didn't know where this sheep's nickname came from. He secretly thought that this nickname was really a stroke of genius. From the looks of it, this sheep was indeed a fat sheep. He would really be sorry if he didn't slaughter it. But on the surface, Ye Shi pretended to admire him, "Who in Gaoricheng doesn't know Young Master Zhang Yang? He is from the Zhang family...the young master of the Zhang family."
Ye Shi wiped his palms and almost made a basket with his flattery. Who knows what status this sheep has in the Zhang family? Don't let it slip by accident and make the fat sheep run away in anger.
Zhang Yang was very pleased with what he heard, and his originally depressed mood improved a lot. Looking at Ye Shi in front of him, he felt pleased with himself. But when he looked at the sword he was selling, his eyes lit up and he seemed to recognize it. He ran to the pile of giant swords and asked with gleaming eyes: "What kind of sword is this?"
"Uh, this is a giant sword." Ye Shi was speechless. Is the giant sword surprising? I remember that there were a lot of people carrying it in the game.The giant sword was a popular item, so Ye Shi would make more of it when he first made it. Therefore, the giant sword was the most popular among the four types of swords in the store.
Seeing that Zhang Yangfei didn't look like a fake, Ye Shi secretly wondered if something like the giant sword had never appeared in the new world. With such a good relationship, he could make a lot of money and fame as the 'originator', but he didn't know if this thing could be patented?
Ye Shi's eyes were filled with stars, as if he saw the beautiful life in the future, and he felt excited. It felt so good to plagiarize other people's creations and become his own.
Zhang Yang originally looked at the giant sword, waiting for the boss's introduction, but he didn't expect to hear anything. When he turned around, he saw that the young boss seemed to be lost in some beautiful longing. It is rude to interrupt someone's thinking, especially the thinking of happiness, but Zhang Yang was still anxious to go back. Seeing that the young boss should be a year or two older than himself, Zhang Yang hesitated and spoke: "Brother, wake up."
"Uh." Ye Shi suddenly woke up. Before he had time to look at Zhang Yang, he felt a little wet on his mouth. Maybe he was drooling. Ye Shi quickly wiped it with his sleeve, and he was relieved when there was nothing on it.
Then he looked at Zhang Yang. Ye Shi saw Zhang Yang's expression of asking for a solution. He rolled his eyes and had an idea, but he still had to introduce it first. "This is a giant sword. As you can see, the giant sword's blade is five times wider and thicker than other swords. It can exert more power when attacking."
Before Ye Shi could finish speaking, Zhang Yang interrupted with some confusion, "What about the flexibility of this sword?"
Flexibility has always been a pain in Zhang Yang's heart. Although he is very interested in this giant sword, it seems that his flexibility will not be improved, but will be pulled down. This makes Zhang Yang hesitate.
"Flexibility?" Ye Shi looked at Zhang Yang strangely, "This sword does not require flexibility at all. With one swing of the sword, no one can get close to you, and you don't have to be afraid of those who are close. Slap him, slap him hard."
This time, Ye Shi stopped before he finished speaking. Seeing Zhang Yang still looking confused, Ye Shi felt that he needed to work hard in order to sell his products. Explaining to Zhang Yang in detail, this giant sword is a weapon that abandons flexibility to obtain power. With one swing of the sword, it can knock out anything around it. As long as it is used properly, this giant sword is a field that no one dares to get close to.
At this time, Ye Shi also saw that Zhang Yang was the kind of person who was not agile but had great strength. The most suitable weapon was a giant sword.
Of course, the giant sword also has its disadvantages, that is, if others keep a distance and do not fight you, most of the people who use the giant sword themselves are clumsy people, and with the giant sword, they will probably just stand and stare.
However, Ye Shi also told Zhang Yang about his shortcomings. He only talked about his strengths and did not expose his weaknesses. He could still fool him for a short time, but his reputation would probably be ruined over time. For the sake of long-term planning, Ye Shi felt it was necessary to be properly honest.
"So good!" Zhang Yang said excitedly, looking at the giant sword with even more intense eyes. If it weren't for the light film separating it, he might have grabbed it and touched it. As for the shortcomings of the giant sword, Zhang Yang ignored it. Ever since he gained weight, Zhang Yang had never looked forward to fighting at a distance.
"Yes, yes." Seeing that the fat sheep took the bait, Ye Shi rubbed his hands with a smile on his face and said with a sincere smile that only a profiteer can have. "Although I know Mr. Zhang Yang doesn't care about this little money, I will not open this store in vain. This giant sword is of the highest quality in our store. It costs two hundred gold coins, and a 40% discount is equivalent to one hundred and twenty gold coins."
"Not expensive, not expensive." Zhang Yang murmured, his eyes completely attracted by the giant sword.
Ye Shi was even more beaming. It was done. Sheep had completely taken the bait. With the sword sold, his urgent problem was finally solved. However, before Ye Shi could be happy for too long, he was interrupted by Zhang Yang's scream.
Zhang YangbenHis attention was all on the giant sword, and he couldn't hear Ye Shi's words clearly. When he reacted, he jumped up in fright, his eyes turned red, and he almost stopped holding Ye Shi's clothes.
"How much did you say? One hundred and twenty gold coins, are you sure it's not one hundred and twenty silver coins?" Zhang Yang shouted in a low voice.
